idea-plugin.name: PR Comments
idea-plugin.description:
Review every GitHub pull request comment without leaving the IDE.

  • Detects the repository and the pull request for the current branch.
  • Lists every review thread with filters for resolved/unresolved, replied/awaiting reply, outdated, author, path and free text.
  • Shows the diff hunk exactly as the code looked when the comment was written, next to the current state of that line in your working tree, with a drift-corrected line number.
  • Reply to and resolve threads inline.
